method: All figures computed by scripts/boe_tax_complexity.py (stdlib) from BOE open data; raw responses cached in etl/data/raw/public_viz/boe/. A) /legislacion-consolidada/id/{id}/analisis -> referencias/posteriores; a later norm is counted once if any of its relations has a label matching '^SE (MODIFICA|AÑADE|DEROGA|SUPRIME|DA NUEVA REDACCI|SUSTITUYE|DEJA SIN EFECTO|SUSPENDE|PRORROGA|AMPLÍA|REDUCE|ELEVA)' (modify/add/partial repeal/suppress/new wording/replace/leave without effect/suspend/extend); excluded: error corrections, court rulings (SE DECLARA), development/implementation (SE DESARROLLA, SE DICTA DE CONFORMIDAD), appeals, citations. Year = BOE publication date of the modifying norm (metadatos; xml.php fallback). Count = distinct modifying norms, not individual changes. B) words = whitespace tokens containing a letter or digit, after stripping XML tags. Original = <texto> of diario_boe/xml.php (BOE metadata/analysis excluded); words_excl_preamble starts at the first structural heading (título/capítulo/artículo) and drops signature lines. Consolidated = last <version> of each <bloque> of /texto, excluding the nota_inicial block and BOE editorial notes (blockquote/nota_pie). 1978 laws have no preamble, so words_excl_preamble is the comparable series. C) block counts by block title in consolidated /texto (tipo=precepto); emptied = current text only says derogado/suprimido/sin contenido.

tax_norms_by_year.query: materia@codigo:<code> with range fecha_publicacion 19600101..20251231, limit=10000 (limit=-1 is silently capped at 50), union of distinct identificador
tax_norms_by_year.scope_caveat: Counts norms present in the BOE consolidated-legislation database (mostly in force or recently consolidated); repealed historical norms are largely absent, so earlier years are undercounted (survivorship). Not a count of all tax norms ever published.
